rows.subtopic: Graphical Solution and the Feasible Region
rows.stem:
Solve the following Linear Programming Problem graphically :

Maximize \(Z = 20x + 10y\)

subject to constraints

\(x + 2y \leq 28\)

\(3x + y \leq 24\)

\(x \geq 2\)

\(x, y \geq 0\)
Using integration, find the area of the region bounded by \(y = 5x + 4\), \(y = 0\), \(x = -1\) and \(x = 1\).

rows.subtopic: Equation of a Line in Space
rows.stem: Find the length of the perpendicular drawn from the point P(1, 2, 3) to the line \(\dfrac{x - 6}{3} = \dfrac{y - 7}{2} = \dfrac{z - 7}{-2}\). Also, find the equation of the perpendicular line joining P and the foot of the perpendicular.
